recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: small voices answering from beneath collapsed stone
aftershocks still rolling through a capital city at dusk
fog burning off a cool san francisco morning
long june daylight stretching past eight-thirty
stutter-house pulses layered over ambient drift
agents sleeping while the phone waits to wake them

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap stutter-house kick patterns as Fred-again-style sample loops stack; miss a beat and the whole groove collapses into silence until you rebuild it.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Each 45-second round is one perfect loop you assemble bar by bar — finishing feels like dropping a track.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: Layers multiply and BPM creeps up; off-beat taps mute random stems.
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon waveform strips on black, pulsing like a booth monitor

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Flick away earthquake rubble tiles to uncover trapped pulse signals — each rescue extends the round but triggers aftershocks that reshuffle the pile.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Clearing three signals in under a minute feels like a breath held then released.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Rubble gets denser, aftershocks arrive faster, false-positive tiles multiply.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: concrete dust and amber rescue lights, paper-tear physics

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw escape paths through a cracking city grid before aftershock fissures seal them — survivors follow your line in real time.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: One clean path that saves everyone in 30 seconds is instantly readable success or failure.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: New cracks spawn mid-draw, paths decay, crowd size grows.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: top-down chalk lines on slate, tremor ripples distorting the map

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Lane-switch through SF fog layers at sunrise — dodge cold marine rolls while collecting warmth pockets before the city fully wakes.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Surfing fog to golden hour in one minute mirrors a real summer morning commute fantasy.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Fog thickens, wind shear pulls lanes, warmth clusters shrink and speed up.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: watercolor hills, pearlescent fog bands, golden rim light
